people.imagined: Noon on the founder's tower, the sea glittering below. He stands with his back to the stone and his face to the water, never the other way. In his hand the old bronze storm lamp burns a pale flame in full sun. He has been up all night again.
people.subject: The moment: at noon on a stone tower top he stands facing the sea with a lit bronze storm lamp held low at his side, the little flame visible even in full daylight. Face: a tall man's long, grave face, salt-greyed, the skin weathered brown and fine-lined by wind; deep-set dark eyes with a faint red rim of sleeplessness, narrowed against the glare; a long straight nose; a thin mouth turned slightly down; a close grey-white beard along the jaw. Hair: grey as sea-foam, tied back tight at the nape with a strip of dark blue pearl-diver's line. Body: tall, upright, lean, never turned from the water. Clothing: a long coat of oiled grey cloth buttoned with brass toggles, over a dark blue robe of the pearl divers with seams stitched in tarred line, the collar high; a brass lamp-hook hung at the belt. Hands and objects: in the right hand a bronze storm lamp with panes of horn glass and a ring handle, a small white-gold flame inside; the left hand rests on the stone parapet. Background: a blurred wide sea, pale grey-blue, a long coast, a gull. Light: hard white noon light from the upper left, the lamp flame glowing in front of it. Expression: unsleeping, weighed down, resolute and silent.

people.imagined: Afternoon on the palace jetty at Thạch Cơ. She stands square on the cracked stone, measuring the sea wall with her eyes as if with a rule, the black jetty shard hanging at her chest. She has been arguing for a century and tires of it, but not of the wall.
people.subject: The moment: standing square on a cracked stone jetty in the afternoon, she measures the wall in front of her with narrowed eyes, one hand lifted with thumb and forefinger set a span apart. Face: a square, strong face, jaw heavy, skin weathered tan; level dark eyes with a sharp, measuring stare under heavy straight brows; a firm flat-bridged nose; lips closed in a stubborn line; a pair of deep lines from nose to mouth. Hair: black with a few grey streaks, cut straight at the jaw, pinned back at the sides with two plain black stone pins. Body: broad square shoulders, solid, planted. Clothing: a coat of salt-stiff oiled grey cloth, white with dried salt at the seams and at the hem, brass toggles, a grey inner robe; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: on a cord at her chest a jagged shard of pale stone, the size of a palm, cracked and rough; her right hand held up with thumb and forefinger measuring; a slab of black stone is behind her left hand on the parapet. Background: blurred grey sea-wall stones, a crack in the stone, grey surf. Light: cool grey afternoon light from the upper left, a bright sea haze. Expression: hard, patient, unconvinced.

people.imagined: Midnight at the seaward tower of a crumbling fort. He holds the lamp low and stares out at a dark sea where he has seen sails with no lamps. He has written, and nobody has answered. His eyes have gone pale from the dark.
people.subject: The moment: at midnight on a ruined fort's seaward tower he stares into black darkness with a lit lamp held up beside his face, the flame lighting one half of it. Face: most important, his eyes are a washed, milky pale grey, nearly white, wide open and fixed. A gaunt, hollowed, deeply weathered face, grey skin the colour of driftwood; cheekbones standing out; a long nose; a thin, cracked mouth, slightly open; a scrubby grey beard. Hair: thin white-grey, hanging lank to the collar, wet with sea spray. Body: tall, bony, stooped at the shoulders. Clothing: a heavy coat of dark grey sealskin with the hair worn short, over an oiled grey coat and a plain grey shirt, the collar turned up; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: a brass storm lamp with horn panes held up at shoulder height in his bony right hand, a small warm flame; the left hand grips a rough stone parapet. Background: deep blue-black night sea, a pale slice of broken wall and stars, a faint sliver of a far sail shape. Light: only lamplight from the lower right, warm yellow on half the face, cold blue light on the other. Expression: tense, staring, lonely and doubting himself.

people.imagined: Early morning in the stores. She is running her salt-cracked fingers along a column of numbers on an abacus, flicking beads, a cup of tea at her elbow. She has just reached the same total again: one year's oil would build a furlong of wall.
people.subject: The moment: in an early-morning storeroom she flicks the beads of a wooden abacus with quick fingers, her eyes up on the viewer with a brisk, level look. Face: most important, her hands, cracked and white at the knuckles from salt, fill the lower frame. A brisk, narrow face with high cheekbones, a sallow tan; sharp dark eyes, alert; thin neat eyebrows; a thin straight nose; a mouth drawn small and tidy; a faint amused crease at one corner; fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black, brushed smooth, twisted into a tight bun at the back held with a brass pin. Body: slim, quick, straight-backed. Clothing: an oiled grey coat, neat, buttoned with brass toggles, a pale grey inner robe with a white collar, sleeves with turned-back cuffs; a brass lamp-hook at the belt and a small wooden abacus hanging by a cord. Hands and objects: a small wooden abacus with dark beads held in the left hand and counted with the fingers of the right, salt-cracked; a clay cup of tea steaming at the edge of the frame. Background: blurred shelves with sacks of salt and bundles of dried laver, jars, a barrel of oil. Light: pale morning light from a window at the upper left. Expression: brisk, shrewd, dry humour.

people.imagined: Dawn at the burned piers. She has just surfaced, hair streaming wet, breathing hard, clutching something in her fist. The pierced lobes of her ears are empty and swollen. She looks over her shoulder, wondering who saw.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn she has just broken the surface among black burned pier posts, head and shoulders out of grey water, one fist raised and closed round something small, and she glances over one shoulder. Face: most important, both ear-lobes are pierced through with large holes, empty and stretched, and clearly visible against the wet hair. A lean, sea-browned face with wide cheekbones; large dark eyes with a restless gleam, lashes wet; a straight nose; a full mouth half open, panting; drops of water running down her cheeks. Hair: black, streaming and plastered to her head and neck. Body: strong shoulders, bare wet arms, wiry. Clothing: a dark grey diver's wrap of tight oiled cloth at the shoulders, a loose grey oiled coat floating at the edge of the water, open; a lamp-hook fastened to the coat. Hands and objects: her right fist closed on something that glints white between the fingers, a pearl; the left hand grips a charred black pier post. Background: the black stumps of burned piers in a mist, a pale grey dawn sea, a dim tower with a small lamp. Light: cold pale dawn light from the upper left, a thin yellow glow from the far lamp. Expression: breathless, alert and guilty, a quick triumph.

people.imagined: Morning in the southern tower among the reed beds. He squints with one eye shut against a sun that is not there. He is trimming a wick with a reed knife. A rope ladder hangs ready to be hauled up.
people.subject: The moment: in a low tower at morning he trims a lamp wick with a small reed knife, one eye tightly shut and the other open, looking at the viewer. Face: most important, his left eye is held tightly shut in a permanent squint, a fan of deep creases around it, the other eye open and unnaturally steady. A long, narrow, hollow face, tanned to the colour of dry reed; a thin straight nose; thin pale lips set calmly; a sparse brown stubble. Hair: dark brown, tied in a rough tail with a strip of reed fibre. Body: very lean, forearms thin as reeds, shoulders narrow. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, neat but plain, brass toggles, a pale reed-green inner shirt with rolled sleeves; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: in his right hand a small curved reed knife; in his left a pale wick of twisted reed pith, its tip freshly cut; both forearms thin and brown. Background: blurred inside of a round lamp room, brass reflectors, a window onto tall reed beds, a coil of rope. Light: pale morning light from a window at the upper left, a gleam on the brass. Expression: calm, patient and unfeeling, with no warmth.

people.imagined: Late afternoon in the founder's tower, where he hangs his plans where the head must see them. He is drawing with a stub of chalk on the edge of his cuff, not noticing. He draws on everything.
people.subject: The moment: in the late afternoon he draws with a chalk stub on the white cuff of his own sleeve, tongue tip showing, absorbed, not looking at the viewer. Face: a mild, round-cheeked scholar's face, pale brown, ink-smudged on the left cheek; round dark eyes cast down at his work, brows lifted; a rounded nose with a smudge of chalk dust; a pursed mouth, the tongue tip between the teeth; a thin moustache. Hair: black, brushed back and pinned in a small knot with a bone pin, one chalk-white streak above the ear. Body: round-shouldered, soft. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, neat but chalk-dusted down the front, brass toggles; the left cuff of the inner pale shirt is covered with tiny chalk diagrams of waves and walls; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: a thin white chalk stub in his right hand held like a brush; the left forearm raised, the cuff covered with small drawn lines; a roll of plans tucked under the left arm. Background: a blurred pale stone tower wall hung with large sheets of drawn plans, sun in a high window. Light: warm slanting light from the upper left. Expression: absorbed, gentle, stubborn.

people.imagined: Dusk at the tide lamp in Nhật Xuất. She is tending the lamp with her left hand, black to the wrist with soot. She wipes her eye with the back of the other, solemn and devout, swearing in the name of her dead ancestor.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk she kneels at a big lamp, her left hand held up black with soot to the wrist like a glove, wiping her eye with the other. Face: most important, her entire left hand and wrist are matte black with lamp soot, in sharp contrast to the rest of her. A solemn, symmetric, oval face, pale brown; level dark eyes, damp at the corners; high straight brows; a straight nose with a smudge of soot at its side; a mouth set in a devout line. Hair: black, in a tight coil at the nape with a plain dark bone pin. Body: slight, upright, kneeling. Clothing: a long coat of oiled grey cloth, clean at the front and sooty at the cuffs, brass toggles, a grey inner shirt, a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: the left hand black with soot up to the wrist, held open in front of her; the right hand wipes her eye; a big lit brass tide lamp glows behind her. Background: a dark round lamp room, glow of a big flame in a brass bowl, blurred. Light: warm yellow light from the lamp, upper right and below, a cool blue dusk outside. Expression: solemn, devout, tearful, closed.

people.imagined: Early evening at a cove, oars shipped, boat tied. He is laughing at his own joke so loudly it echoes. His nose, broken flat by an oar, spreads wide as he laughs. At night he has drawn nine hulls on the stair wall.
people.subject: The moment: at the cove in the evening he throws his head back and laughs loudly with his mouth wide, one hand slapping the oar on his shoulder. Face: most important, his nose is flattened and spread wide across his face like a boxer's, a crooked, broken bridge visible from the front. A broad, sunburnt, boyish face, cheeks round and red; small bright dark eyes squeezed shut with laughter; a mouth gaping open, strong crooked teeth; a few wisps of beard. Hair: black, damp and tousled, tied with a bit of twine. Body: stocky, broad-chested, strong. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth with the sleeves hitched high, brass toggles open; a grey inner shirt wet at the cuffs; a brass lamp-hook hung from the belt. Hands and objects: a long wooden oar with a worn blade resting on his shoulder, held by the right hand; the left hand slaps his knee. Two fingers of the right hand are wrapped in cloth against old cold-bite, and a coil of rope lies over the oar. Background: a blurred small boat on dark water, a rocky cove, a pale sky at sundown. A beached oil-boat with a dark hull lies half in the frame, and the cove's grey rocks glisten with wet. Light: warm low gold light from the upper left. Expression: uproarious, open, honest.

people.imagined: A grey day at the salt pans, ledger-clerk at a counter. She counts a sum with four fingers of her left hand. She shows the sum openly in the margin for anyone. She has never needed a fifth finger.
people.subject: The moment: at a counting table in a salt-pan shed she holds up four fingers of her left hand, thumb folded, counting a sum aloud and openly, with a frank, direct look at the viewer. Face: a plain, honest, round face, wind-pinked and salt-dried across the nose, with wide-set grey eyes, steady and clear, straight brows, a short straight nose, a broad, generous mouth in a slight smile, and a few freckles. Hair: dark brown, braided in two thick plaits pinned up on her head. Body: sturdy, solid and practical, sitting square to the table. Clothing: a short coat of oiled grey cloth, clean and neatly buttoned with brass toggles, over a grey shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a faint salt crust at the cuffs; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: the left hand held up with four fingers raised and the thumb tucked into the palm; the right hand rests on a thick stack of bound paper sheets tied with string; beside her a small heap of white salt crystals in a wooden dish. Background: a blurred shed with grey salt pans seen through an open door, a pale overcast sky. Light: soft grey daylight from the upper left, with a faint white sparkle on the salt. Expression: frank and steady, quietly good-humoured, the calm face of a ledger-clerk who has never needed a fifth finger.

people.imagined: Dawn on the shore. She coughs up a little seawater into her fist, though she has not dived in a week. Wet hair at the temples. A pearl-fisher's girl who has been told not to dive and dives anyway in the dark.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on the shore she bends slightly, one fist to her mouth in a cough, a trickle of water at the lip, eyes lifted guiltily to the viewer; a pearl-fisher's girl who was told not to dive and dived anyway in the dark. Face: a thin, quick, bright face with a scrap of seaweed in the damp hair, large water-bright dark eyes shining with defiance, narrow arched brows, a small nose, a wet, full mouth, pale skin with a flush at the cheeks and damp curls at the temples. Hair: black, tangled and still damp, twisted in a rough knot. Body: slight and wiry, hunched with the cough, gooseflesh standing on her bare forearms and the wet cloth clinging in dark stains across her narrow shoulders. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, neat but damp at the cuffs and collar, with brass toggles over a grey shirt, and a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: the right fist at her lips; the left hand holds a small blue-green stone pendant on a wet cord at her chest. Background: a pale grey dawn shore, wet sand, dark water, a distant tower lamp, and a line of black burned pier posts running out into the water, a rope hanging between two of them and a gull on the farthest. Light: cold light from the upper left, a faint blue sheen on the wet hair. Expression: guilty yet defiant, brave, chin lifted over the cough.

people.imagined: A quiet evening at the southern lamp. He sits among bundles of reeds, patient, hands scarred, speaking softly to the reeds he is cutting. He says the oil would be better spent on walls, and says it only to them.
people.subject: The moment: seated in the evening among tied bundles of pale reeds, he cuts a reed with a small knife and murmurs to it, eyes down, gentle. Face: a quiet, long, still face; light brown skin; heavy-lidded brown eyes cast down; faint brow lines; a straight nose; a small smile at one corner of the mouth; sparse young beard. His brows are thin and pale as dry reed, and his lashes are long and lowered, so that his gaze is half hidden. Hair: light brown, tied back in a thin tail with a reed. Body: lean, relaxed, shoulders sloping. He sits cross-legged on a straw mat with his back slightly bowed over his work, shoulders soft and unhurried. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, neat, worn open, brass toggles; a green-grey shirt, sleeves rolled to the elbow; a brass lamp-hook. Hands and objects: both hands full of pale reeds, every finger marked with fine white healed cuts, a small reed knife in the right hand; reed pith shavings fall in his lap. Background: blurred bundles of reeds, a dim lamp, a window with sunset. Light: warm amber evening light from the upper left. A last bar of low sun lights the pale reed bundles, so that they glow like straw-gold bars around him. Expression: gentle, content, withdrawn.

people.imagined: Night, at the tide lamp. She has stood the night on the tower top without a lamp and looks at the viewer a breath too long. Her hands are cracked and raw from the ice. She no longer apologises for her stare.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a lamp she looks directly at the viewer, unblinking, a breath too long, her hands held in front of her raw and cracked. Face: a pale thin face with dark circles under the eyes; wide, unblinking dark eyes with a steady stare; thin brows lifted slightly; a straight nose reddened by cold; chapped lips pressed together; a hollow in each cheek. A faint scatter of frost-bitten red marks lies across the bridge of her nose, and there is a small cut on her lower lip. Hair: black, in a single plain braid over the shoulder, frost on the strands. Body: small and thin, straight backed. Clothing: an oiled grey coat, clean and small on her, brass toggles done up to the throat; a grey wool scarf; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Her sleeves are too long and are rolled twice over the wrists, so the cuffs look swollen, and one toggle is missing from the coat and replaced with a knot of cord. Hands and objects: both hands held at chest height, palms in, the skin split and red with chilblains, the knuckles swollen; a lit brass lamp on the stone beside her. Background: a dark blue night, tower stones, a few stars, blurred. Light: a warm yellow from the lamp on the lower right of her face, cold blue from the night above. Expression: fixed, unblinking and steady, grief closed in.

people.imagined: An afternoon on the fort wall. He grins and shows the smudged pirate mark he inked on his own forearm in lamp soot. He holds a nail in his other hand. Gulls scream behind him. He looks like a boy who wants a pirate to exist.
people.subject: The moment: on a fort wall in the afternoon he holds up his forearm to show a smudged soot tattoo while grinning slowly, a large iron nail in the other hand. Face: most important, a grin held too long and a little too wide, the eyes not joining in. A lean, sunburnt, handsome face with high cheeks; narrow, bright, pale brown eyes with no warmth; thick dark brows; a straight nose; a wide mouth with a slow lopsided smile that stays after it should have gone. Hair: black, spiky and sticking up, with a red rag tied round the brow like a pirate. Body: wiry, forward-leaning, long arms. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, worn open at the chest, brass toggles; a grey shirt with the left sleeve pushed up; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. Hands and objects: on the left forearm a smudged black soot tattoo of a skull with crossed oars, fingerprint-smeared; the right hand rolls a long iron nail between finger and thumb. Background: a blurred crumbling fort wall, a few dark gulls in a sharp sky. Light: bright hard afternoon light from the upper left, deep shadows. Expression: a long unblinking grin, cold and eager.

people.imagined: A morning at the burned piers. She stands with a lamp, her hair salt-white and drying even as she watches Trạm Châu Nhi dive. She is soft-hearted and trusting; the oath was for an aunt the sea took.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a burned pier at morning she looks down at the water with a kind, anxious face, one hand held out as if to help someone below. Face: most important, her hair is dry salt-white, a crusted pale grey-white all the way from the root, standing out against her brown skin. A soft, round, young face with big warm brown eyes, brows tilted in worry; a small nose; a gentle mouth; a few freckles. Fine laughter lines already show at the corners of her eyes though she is young, and a small gold stud shines in the left ear. Hair: salt-white, in a long plain tail down her back, strands stiff with dried salt. Body: slim, soft-shouldered, leaning forward. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, neat and clean, brass toggles, a grey scarf; a brass lamp-hook at the belt; a small brass lamp unlit beside her. A grey scarf with a salt-bleached edge is wound twice round her neck, and the coat's hem is stiff and pale with dried sea-salt. Hands and objects: the right hand extended down toward the water, palm open; the left holds a small unlit lamp. Background: black burned piers, mist, grey-green water, pale morning sky. Light: soft pale light from the upper left. The pale morning sun picks out the white of her hair like frost, and a faint pearly sheen lies on the wet pier. Expression: kind, worried, trusting.

people.imagined: In the fort kitchen by lamplight. He lights the lamp with a taper and turns his face away, aware of the viewer. A wisp of beard sits over the scar on his lip. He is lying to the keeper about the oil.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim fort kitchen he lights a lamp wick with a taper and turns his face half away, a sidelong look at the viewer; he is lying to the keeper about the oil. Face: most important, a pale harelip scar splits his upper lip up to the left nostril, ridged and pink, half hidden by a thin wisp of beard that does not cover it. It is a long, narrow, sallow face with small, shifty light-brown eyes in a sideways glance, a thin nose pulled slightly aside by the scar so the left nostril sits higher, and stubble; his eyes slide away whenever someone looks straight at him. Hair: dark brown, thin and lank, tucked behind his ears. Body: thin and slouched, shoulders drawn in. Clothing: a clean coat of oiled grey cloth, its seam neatly mended, over a plain grey shirt, a brass lamp-hook at the belt, and a cloth tied at the waist as an apron. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a lit taper to a brass lamp; the left shields the flame; a small oil flask stands on the table. Background: a dim stone kitchen with a hanging pot, a blurred barrel, a bundle of garlic and a string of dried fish hanging from the beams, a little spilled oil shining on the table. Light: warm lamplight from below right, shadow across the other half of the face. Expression: secretive and wary, a furtive, watchful tightness, the face of a man rehearsing an answer.

people.imagined: A bright morning, plans in hand. She signs her name alone beneath the breakwater drawing. The seams of her nails are stained laver green. She speaks to the head without fear.
people.subject: The moment: in morning light she holds up a rolled sheet of drawn plans and looks straight at the viewer, chin raised, with confident, practised poise. Face: a firm, angular, handsome face, tanned; sharp, dark, direct eyes; strongly arched brows; a straight nose; a well-shaped mouth with a small tilted smile; a clear, ambitious jaw. A small mole sits at the right corner of her mouth, and her gaze is held a moment longer than is comfortable. Hair: black, in a high smooth tail bound with a green cord. Body: tall, straight, shoulders back. She holds the plan roll like a baton, the elbow out, with the confident lean of someone who expects to be listened to. Clothing: a coat of oiled grey cloth, neat, brass toggles, the collar standing up; a grey shirt; sleeves with narrow cuffs; a brass lamp-hook at the belt. A narrow green silk cord ties the hair, and a small brass pin in the shape of a wave fastens the coat's collar. Hands and objects: her left hand holds a rolled plan sheet drawn with waves and walls; the fingernails of both hands carry fine laver-green stains at the seams, clearly visible. Background: a blurred pale stone wall with a sunlit window and the sea. A second roll of plans leans against a table at the edge of the frame, and a model of a breakwater built of small stones sits on the sill. Light: crisp morning light from the upper left. Expression: confident, composed, calculating.

people.imagined: A hot afternoon by the oil cauldron. He sits slumped on a stool, half asleep through the second boil, gulls wheeling round his head. He smells of fish oil in every season.
people.subject: The moment: slumped on a stool by a giant cauldron in the afternoon, he dozes with his head tipped, one eye cracked open, gulls clustered near his shoulder. Face: a broad, round, greasy face, shiny with oil, brown skin loose at the jowls; small sleepy eyes with heavy lids, one open to a slit; a big shapeless nose; a loose wet mouth, drooping; grey stubble; a content slackness. A gleam of fish oil shines on his forehead and nose and a film of grease on the jowls. Hair: thin grey, plastered to the scalp, shiny with oil. Body: heavy, soft, slumped, belly round. Clothing: a stained but whole oiled grey coat, unbuttoned and straining; a grey shirt with the sleeves rolled, grease-dark on the forearms; a brass lamp-hook. The coat's pockets sag, one holding a lump of dried salt fish, and the toggles are done up in the wrong holes so the front hangs crooked. Hands and objects: a long wooden paddle in his slack right hand, its end resting in the cauldron of golden oil; the left hand hangs over his knee; three grey and white gulls perch on the cauldron rim and the stool. Background: a blurred shed, a huge iron cauldron with steam, barrels. Casks of oil with wet rims stand in rows behind the cauldron, and a thin plume of steam drifts over a heap of fish heads. Light: warm hazy light from the upper left, steam. Expression: drowsy, contented, lazy.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at twenty-two, the night Châu Lệ Cảng burned: a pearl diver on a black pier with the harbour burning orange behind her, standing straight, not weeping, taking its name for her own.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a young pearl diver standing straight on a black pier with a burning harbour behind her. Face: most important, a hard, set young face lit orange on one side; a lean, brown, high-cheeked face; wide dark eyes that do not blink, reflecting small flames; straight dark brows; a short straight nose; a mouth pressed shut and pale, with a tight jaw; a streak of soot across the cheek. Fine droplets of water cling to her eyelashes, and a small scar from a coral cut shows white at the left temple. Hair: black, wet and long, hanging over one shoulder in a thick rope, a strip of blue diver's line wound round it. Body: strong, slim, shoulders squared, upright. Clothing: a dark blue diver's tunic with seams stitched in tarred line, a coarse grey sea-cloak over one shoulder; bare strong arms. Hands and objects: both hands hang at her sides, the right one holding a single large grey pearl between finger and thumb, plain and visible. Background: a wash of orange and black smoke, the outline of burning piers and masts, faded. Over the burning masts a flock of dark birds wheels upward, and the water at the pier's foot reflects the orange glow. Light: faint, even, as on old silk, with an orange glow on the left cheek. Expression: stony, grieving, resolved.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the sworn brother at the Kim Sa lamp on the festival night of 913, as the storm tide rises: he keeps the lamp burning with his own coat held over it, laughing in the wind, trusting his friend will return.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, of a man shielding a lamp from rain and spray with the flap of his coat, smiling into the wind. Face: a broad, friendly, weathered brown face with deep laugh lines; bright dark eyes crinkled with a trusting warmth; thick black brows; a broad nose; a wide mouth in an open smile with strong teeth; a short black beard flecked with spray. Hair: black, wet with sea spray, a dark blue cloth knotted round the head. A strand of dark sea-wrack is tangled in the knotted cloth, and drops of spray gleam in his beard. Body: big, broad-shouldered, a stance braced against wind. Clothing: a dark blue robe of the pearl-diver kind with seams stitched in tarred line, a coat of oiled grey cloth thrown over the shoulder and held up like a shield; sleeves wet. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small bronze lamp in a nest of coat cloth, the flame low and bright, shielded from the storm. Background: a wash of dark grey and blue, rain slants and a pale tide rising, faded. At the far edge a pale line of tall breakers rises above the dark town's roofs, faded to ghostly white. Light: faint, even as on old silk, a warm glow from the lamp on the chin. Expression: trusting, warm, a laugh against the storm.
